notes.title: New Hero Lady V + New Map + New Game Mode
notes.notes:
Finally, here's our big Update that we've been waiting for:

[h1] New Hero:  Lady V[/h1]
Lady V flies around with her Gravitation guns, with the ability to "Blink" teleport in the air.  Her gravitation gun shoots lightning bolts that follows the enemies. 
 And her super power is to summon a huge Black Hole!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373517/80ec0583627419cbf46e45a860fbe5cda5ea0950.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Map: Iceberg[/h1]
Inside the deep crack of a floating iceberg sheet is Lady V's secret hide out base of the resistance army she commands.  Explore the underwater world!

[h1] New Game Mode: Team Deathmatch[/h1]
Engage in classic team deathmatch to see whose team can get the highest kills!

[h1] New Lobby[/h1]
The new lobby allows you to switch between Heroes to learn the basics.  It's also a great place to hang out with your friends!

And, of course, bunch of bug fixes

notes.title: Our first major Update: Co-op Escort mode!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373517/1a45ef8e04f1282642f2221a30030a65e6b369b8.jpg[/img]

We have heard many feedback and suggestions about adding co-op game modes that allow players to team up against A.I.  This was a great suggestion as the VR community is still small and it is difficult to always find people to play Team game modes.  

So we've been hard at work with a new Co-op Escort game mode.  Similar to our beloved Team Escort game mode, in Co-op escort, players team up to escort a airship to the destination, while fighting off the A.I.  This allows for 1-4 players in each game.

We've added some new A.I that we're quite happy with.  These drones use a different algorithm for flying path finding and have great performance and really gives life to the A.I.

We will continue to refine this game mode, so let us know what you think!  Going foward we will develop more co-op game modes.  One of the idea is a Co-op Base defense against A.I.  Do you have have any other co-op ideas?

Give this Co-op Escort mode a try, and let us know of your thoughts!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373517/437f084666e2fc081d3a85d5f5cff7ee147676b5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Re-Balanced Heroes - Energy regeneration speed
notes.notes:
There had been feedback from our beta testers about how the energy never seemed enough to use for jet-9.  Often times, energy would run out for Jet-9 in mid battle, which can really ruin the rhythm of the game.

We changed the mechanics so that now players no longer have to go around hunting for energy!  There is no longer energy power up requirements.  The only powers you need to collect are the health.  Jet-9 has a quick energy regen ability, whereas draco has slow energy regen. They both have basic attacks they can do that do not require energy.  More advanced attacks will require energy.

After our beta testing it seems like this is the right direction to go.  So we will stick with it!
